ai_privacy.bullet_1: Your photo or voice recording is sent securely through our server to OpenAI for analysis.
ai_privacy.bullet_2: OpenAI identifies the food and estimates protein, carbs, fat, calories, and GLP-1 micronutrients (B-12, vitamin D, magnesium, zinc).
ai_privacy.bullet_3: Your photo or audio is never stored on GLiPra servers. Only the nutrition results are saved to your log.
ai_privacy.bullet_4: Results are estimates only. Accuracy varies by meal complexity, typically within 15 to 25 percent.
ai_privacy.title: Before your first scan.
ai_privacy.trust_body: Your photos, voice recordings, and health data are never sold, shared with advertisers, or used to train AI models. GLiPra earns revenue from subscriptions only.
ai_privacy.trust_title: Data not used for ads or training
ai_privacy.warning_body: AI nutrition estimates are for general wellness tracking only. Consult a registered dietitian or your prescriber before making significant dietary changes.

dose.tip_pinch_body: Pinch 1 to 2 inches of skin and inject at 90 degrees. Release the pinch before withdrawing the pen.
dose.tip_rotate_body: Use a different spot each time to allow tissue to recover and maintain consistent absorption.

tips.muscle: Your muscle score blends how consistently you hit your protein floor with how often you train. Small, steady habits protect lean mass while GLP-1 does its job.
tips.protein: Hitting 80% or more of your protein floor protects lean muscle while GLP-1 does its job. Aim for consistency over perfection.
tips.symptoms: Symptoms usually settle as your body adjusts. Symptoms persisting beyond two weeks or sharply worsening deserve a prescriber conversation.
tips.weight: Your weight line connects every entry you log. Day-to-day swings are normal - hydration and food timing affect the scale. Look at the direction over weeks, not single days.
